title: PRD-5 City line (6.x code, do not use)
summary: Closed legacy Ledgerline 6.x cost centre for the City line, closed on 2019-03-31; superseded by modern cost centres.

infobox.Name: City line (6.x code, do not use)

body:
Cost centre PRD-5 is a legacy Ledgerline 6.x cost centre for the City line that is designated as do not use [^r1]. The cost centre was closed on 2019-03-31 and cannot be used for current postings or requisitions [^r1]. It remains listed in the master records under owner GSUTCLIFFE and operating unit NBC-MAN-01 [^r1].

## Details

Cost centre PRD-5 is recorded under unit NBC-MAN-01 with GSUTCLIFFE assigned as the owner [^r1]. The account carries a status of CLOSED effective 2019-03-31 [^r1].

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Cost Centre | PRD-5 [^r1] |
| Description | City line (6.x code, do not use) [^r1] |
| Owner | GSUTCLIFFE [^r1] |
| Business Unit | NBC-MAN-01 [^r1] |
| Status | CLOSED [^r1] |
| Closed Date | 2019-03-31 [^r1] |

## Versions and conflicts

Today's active production for city e-bikes uses current Ledgerline codes such as [[cc-prd-05|PRD-05 City e-bike line, regular production]], whereas PRD-5 is an older 6.x code that closed on 2019-03-31 and must not be used [^r1].
